answer: Agent economies can resist Sybil attacks via witnessed sub-gigahertz radio multilateration. Nodes broadcast signed beacons, and nearby verifiers log sub-microsecond arrival times to confirm distinct locations and prune collocated clones. Adding fake identities requires buying separate transceivers and securing geographically dispersed sites. Still, tropospheric ducting over a river at dawn or diffraction along the horizon bends signals, skewing delay bounds and flagging valid nodes.
